swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS54231DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D) while TPS5430DDAR uses SOIC-8E (8-pin, DDA (8-Pin HSOIC PowerPAD)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (SS vs FB), Pin 5 (FB vs EN), Pin 6 (COMP vs GND), Pin 7 (GND vs VIN). Soldering TPS5430DDAR onto a TPS54231DR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOIC-8: NONE vs SOIC-8E: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: TPS5430DDAR cannot regulate below 1.221 V (p.5) vs TPS54231DR down to 0.8 V (p.1); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (TPS54231DR: 0.8 V p.6 vs TPS5430DDAR: 1.221 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54231DR: 10 µH p.14 vs TPS5430DDAR: 15 µH p.14); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (TPS54231DR: 28 V p.5 vs TPS5430DDAR: 36 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS54231DR specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS5430DDAR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS54231DR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (30 V, p.5) than TPS5430DDAR (40 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 30 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 175% higher on TPS54231DR (TPS54231DR: 116.3 °C/W p.5 vs TPS5430DDAR: 42.3 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TPS5430DDAR requires Vin,min >= 5.5 V (p.4) vs 3.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (TPS54231DR: -40..150 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +150°C TJ) vs TPS5430DDAR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); TPS5430DDAR hot limit only 125 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION EN ABS MAX: EN pin absolute maximum differs (TPS54231DR: 6 V vs TPS5430DDAR: 7 V); tying EN directly to VIN may exceed the lower rating.
engineering_verdict: TPS54231DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and TPS5430DDAR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8E) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (SS vs FB), Pin 5 (FB vs EN), Pin 6 (COMP vs GND), Pin 7 (GND vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 2 (VIN vs NC), Pin 3 (EN vs NC), Pin 4 (SS vs FB), Pin 5 (FB vs EN). Power-stage deltas: buck (non-sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency 570 kHz (p.6) vs 500 kHz (p.5) (1.1x ratio), typical inductor 10 µH (p.14) vs 15 µH (p.14), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.6) vs 1.221 V (p.5), and package θJA 116.3 vs 42.3 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS54231DR "EN Pin Abs Max Is Strictly 6.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V or 24 V VIN" (p.5) and TPS5430DDAR "7 V Abs Max ENA Pin Trap & Float-to-Enable — Tying ENA to 12 V/24 V VIN Destroys TPS5430DDAR" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose TPS54231DR when light-load battery standby needs 75 µA Iq; choose TPS5430DDAR when bus voltage exceeds 28 V (rated to 36 V) or higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.4 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
